intent: commits.py: fix inverted arg order in docstring + fallback usage message
notes: Fix v2.6.1 quick win #2 from the roadmap: the enterprise-cli `commits` subcommand's docstring and fallback usage message both quoted `commits <sha> transcripts` (URL shape), but the actual argparse structure is `commits transcripts <sha>` (verb-first) — argparse resolves subcommand groups before positionals. Caught during smoke-test Run 1 as Finding #8 (evaluator-mislead vector — someone reading the docstring to learn the syntax gets a command shape that argparse rejects).

`enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/commits.py:3` — docstring updated to the correct shape + parenthetical spelling out the verb-first-vs-URL-shape rationale so future readers don't re-introduce the inversion.

`enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/commits.py:38` — `handle()` fallback usage message corrected; also added `[--repo <id>]` since the arg exists and the shorter message previously hid it.
`.gator/roadmap.md:202` — user-facing example command inside the "What Enterprise adds" block corrected.

`CHANGELOG.md:13` (v2.6.0 release entry) — CHANGELOG is a historical release record; the correct pattern is a new entry at v2.6.1 CHANGELOG time noting this fix, not rewriting the v2.6.0 line. Leaving as-is preserves the release-notes convention.
